text:
sam: Heads-up — cutover in ~50m. We need 2x LGTM on these three PRs or we hold the release: #8721 (kv-cache warmup race), #8734 (quant default tweak), #8740 (canary fallback routing). Links: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/8721 https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/8734 https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/8740

nina: @sam I'm +1 on #8734, ran the unit tests locally, small doc nit only. I can give LGTM once CI finishes :thumbsup:

raj: I'll take a look at #8721 now — saw a race in the repro logs, leaving a comment. pinging @maria for a second set of eyes on the warmup order.

ci-bot: build started for PR #8721 — unit tests running.

maria: on it, going to run the warmup flow against staging (kv nodes) and post results here. ETA ~12m.

sam: thanks. Quick rules: if #8721 is green +1 from raj and maria before T-20, we merge all three. If #8721 still flaky, we will cherry-pick #8734 & #8740 and ship without kv warmup fix, aim to backlog #8721 for a follow-up patch.

raj: found the race — ordering of cache init vs. token refill. Pushed a tiny fix to the PR, tests now reproduce less often. Will rerun CI.

ci-bot: PR #8721 — unit tests failed on a flaky timeout (1/10), re-queued. PR #8734 — build passed. PR #8740 — build passed.

maria: staging warmup smoke passed (no OOM, kv-cache counters stable). I can give LGTM on #8721 if CI goes green on the re-run.

nina: giving formal LGTM on #8734 now — posted review approval.

sam: @maria @raj awesome. Who can click merge if everything is green? I'll be on-call for rollback if needed.

raj: I'll watch CI; if green I can merge and trigger canary.

ci-bot: PR #8721 — all checks passed.

raj: merging #8721 now. /merge https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/8721

ci-bot: PR #8721 merged into main by raj. Canary job triggered.

maria: Canary smoke (10% traffic) healthy after 5m. No regressions observed. I'm posting metrics in the dashboard.

sam: Excellent. With raj+maria LGTM on #8721 and nina+maria on #8734, we have 2x LGTM across the set. Proceeding with release cut. Thanks all for the quick turnaround :rocket:

nina: great job team — leaving a note for post-release follow-up to re-run longer load tests on #8721 changes.

sam: added to post-release checklist.

ci-bot: Release pipeline started for v1.12.3. Notifications will go out when complete.
